Author: @605Prods
Content: To unlink Nether portals in Minecraft, you need to make sure they don’t automatically connect based on the game’s coordinate system. When a portal is created in the Overworld, the game divides its X and Z coordinates by 8 to find the corresponding location in the Nether. Similarly, when a portal is built in the Nether, the game multiplies the X and Z coordinates by 8 to determine where it should link in the Overworld. If two portals are too close to each other, they might link incorrectly. To fix this, you should move the portals further apart—at least 1024 blocks in the Overworld (which translates to 128 blocks in the Nether) to avoid automatic linking. Alternatively, you can manually link portals by calculating the correct Nether or Overworld coordinates, then building and lighting a portal in the exact spot where you want it to connect. Breaking any interfering portals nearby also helps force the game to generate a new link. If unwanted portal links persist, blocking an existing portal with solid blocks can sometimes make the game create a new one elsewhere.

Author: @c_dang
Content:
1. Remove the portal that's in the cave before making your way towards your main portal at the village. You'll need to get the X & Z coordinates of its location.
2. Once you did, divide the "X" coordinate by 8, then divide the "Z" coordinate by 8. That will be your new X & Z coordinates that you need in the Nether.
2. Thereafter, travel to the Nether and destroy the current portal you spawn into. Rebuild it at the new coordinates that you got and your portal should link properly.

Content:
HERES HOW TO FIX:

1. Remove the portal that's in the cave before making your way towards your main portal at the village. You'll need to get the X & Z coordinates of its location.
2. Once you did, divide the "X" coordinate by 8, then divide the "Z" coordinate by 8. That will be your new X & Z coordinates that you need in the Nether.
2. Thereafter, travel to the Nether and destroy the current portal you spawn into. Rebuild it at the new coordinates that you got and your portal should link properly!
